description:
Software Engineer 
 Location: New York 
 Type: Full-time, Hybrid 
 Job Summary 
 Help the eClerx US AI Organization build and deploy AI-enabled software for clients in financial services and other industries. Working with experienced engineers, domain specialists, and the product team, you will build agentic workflows and full-stack features, test them against real requirements, and help move promising demonstrations and MVPs into deployable software. This is an early-career role with room to develop your engineering judgment.
 Once you are integrated into the team, there might be client-facing work and opportunities depending on your team placement, such as joining client working sessions and presenting your work.
 Responsibilities 
 Build and improve agentic workflows, prototypes, application features, and APIs.

 Implement authentication, authorization, secure configuration, and data integrations.

 Test outputs and features against real requirements, investigate problems, and explain your findings.

 Improve testing, logs, monitoring, and deployment, primarily on AWS and sometimes on GCP or Azure.

 Contribute to work involving enterprise data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.

 Learn from senior engineers and solution builders, and document changes for ongoing product ownership.

 Follow developments in AI and in the industries you serve.

 Eligibility Requirements 
 Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or software engineering.

 0–3 years of full-time experience building software products for customers or internal business users.

 Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language), including writing, testing, and debugging code.

 Experience with REST APIs, SQL, structured and unstructured data, and Git.

 Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications or agentic workflows, through projects, internships, or work.

 Ability to test AI outputs against requirements and identify failure modes.

 Practical AWS experience and the ability to learn GCP or Azure.

 An instinct to consider access, credentials, security, and reliability when designing a feature.

 A proactive approach: you raise questions, flag issues early, and look for ways to improve the work without waiting to be asked.

 Clear communication, collaboration, and ability to learn unfamiliar systems. Client-facing experience is welcome but not required.

 Preferred Qualifications
 Familiarity with Docker and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes.

 Familiarity with fine-tuning models and with up-to-date AI models and their capabilities. 

 Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, or a comparable platform. 

 Startup or early-stage product experience. 

 Exposure to financial services, including financial crime and compliance (FCC), know your customer (KYC), or anti-money laundering (AML); or to communications, media, telecommunications, finance and accounting industries. 

 Publications in top journals, teaching or mentoring experience, or open source contributions. 

 In the US, the target base salary for this role is $75,000-$115,000. Compensation is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and geography. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall throughout the range based on these factors 
 About eClerx 
 eClerx is a leading provider of productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. ​ 

The firm provides business process management, automation, and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world’s leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, and technology companies. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. The firm employs more than 19,000 people across Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Switzerland, Egypt. India, Italy, Netherlands, Peru, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, the UK, and the USA.
